copy.headline: San Antonio man found guilty of intoxication manslaughter after fatal I-10 crash, officials say
copy.caption: A Kendall County jury also found Allen Remard Graham Jr., 28, guilty of manslaughter and intoxication assault. The crash happened on Feb. 16, 2025, around 6:30 a.m.
